sources.name: Official brand assets
sources.role: Published lockups and Devin color chips

meta.relationship: Cognition is the applied AI lab. Devin is its AI software-engineer product. Both sites share one type stack, paper field, electric-indigo accent, four-dot mark, and ink button system. Cognition.com is an editorial column layout. Devin.ai is a product-marketing site with fluid type, a sticky top nav, product chrome screenshots, and dark feature bands.

mark.name: Four-dot cluster / tetramino
mark.description: Four filled rounded-square cells arranged as a compact cluster. Black on paper, white on dark. TRADEMARK: do not reproduce; use only as inspiration for spacing/rhythm.

principles: Paper field instead of pure white
Electric indigo as the only loud accent
Headings in a multiplex neo-grotesque; body in a book serif on the company site
Product UI may introduce Inter, IBM Plex Mono, and Devin Blue #317CFF

heading.name: NB International Pro
heading.notes: Commercial. Cognition uses 400 for H1; Devin uses 500 for display, -0.04em tracking.

bodySerif.name: STK Bureau Serif
bodySerif.role: Cognition body copy, article cards, 10px captions

cognition.caption: serif 10px / 150% rgba(25,25,25,0.56)
cognition.inlineLink: dotted underline 1px black/30, offset 4px; hover indigo

cognition.com.aesthetic: Editorial research-lab. Newspaper column grid, hairline vertical rules, numbered sections, fixed left rail. Almost no color except indigo on the active item.

layout.structure: Fixed left sidebar + multi-column content well + outer paper margins
layout.sidebarActiveState: Indigo text plus a 2px indigo tick on the left of the item
layout.rules: 1px vertical rules in rgba(0,0,0,0.06) divide sidebar, gutter, and content
layout.footer: Top hairline, lockup, legal columns, paper background

components.logoRow: grayscale mid-gray logos on a slightly cooler paper band
components.leaderboard: white inset table with 1px border, alternating paper/white rows, thin horizontal meters in green/rust/indigo
components.articleCarousel: 16:9 stills, no radius, film-grain/wireframe imagery; serif 16px titles; muted dates 09.10.26; square prev/next controls

cognition.com.imagery: Black-and-white or near-mono photography, technical line drawings, film grain, architectural grids. No icons in marketing chrome besides the mark.

devin.ai.aesthetic: Same paper-and-ink system scaled into a product landing page. Centered display type, sticky top navigation, large product screenshot, then a dark collaborative band. Indigo used as a word highlighter rather than a fill.

layout.header: sticky top, paper bg, 1px bottom hairline; mark + nav left; text link + outlined Log in + filled Get Started right
layout.hero: Centered H1, two compact CTAs, floating product window with 12-16px radius and light drop shadow
layout.darkBand: #191919 band, #E7E7E7 copy capped ~35ch, 12-16px cards #1F1F1F, uppercase 12px tag pills (e.g. COLLABORATE)

components.emphasizedWord: same display face, color #2200FF (e.g. 'Build with Devin', 'work together')

devin.ai.imagery: Live-looking product UI screenshots, not illustration. Dark band is typographic.
